title: Unlocking Bonuses: Buy Airtime from Any Network and Earn Rewards
body_markdown:
We are thrilled to announce an exciting opportunity for our valued users! As part of our commitment to providing exceptional service and rewarding our loyal customers, we are introducing a special offer that allows you to earn bonuses when you purchase airtime from any network. By simply linking your Bank Verification Number (BVN), you can enjoy a 5% bonus on your airtime purchases. But that’s not all! If you upload your documents through our convenient self-service app, you can unlock even more rewards, earning up to 1.5% on bills paid. Read on to discover how you can take advantage of this fantastic opportunity!


Enjoy a whooping 5% bonus on airtime purchases from any network


1. Link Your BVN and Earn a 5% Bonus: By linking your BVN to our platform, you open the door to an exclusive bonus program. Every time you buy airtime from any network, you will receive a 5% bonus. This means that for every ₦1000 worth of airtime you purchase, you will receive an additional ₦50! It’s our way of saying thank you for choosing our services and entrusting us with your telecommunication needs.
2. Unlock Additional Bonuses by Uploading Documents: To further enhance your earning potential, we invite you to upload your documents via our user-friendly self-service app. By doing so, you can access even more rewards! For each bill payment made through our platform, you will earn up to 1.5% in bonuses. It’s a simple and convenient way to maximize your benefits while ensuring seamless transactions.
3. Download Our Self-Service App: To get started on your journey to earning extra bonuses on bills, all you need to do is download our self-service app. Available for both iOS and Android devices, our app offers a secure and user-friendly platform for managing your telecommunications needs. Once downloaded, you can easily link your BVN and upload your documents, putting yourself on the fast track to enjoying the benefits of our bonus program.
4. Secure Transactions and Privacy: We understand that security and privacy are of utmost importance to our customers. Rest assured that we have implemented robust security measures to protect your personal information. We adhere to strict data protection standards and ensure that your data is handled with the utmost care and confidentiality.


Enjoy a 1.5% bonus when you pay for Electricity, Cable and Water bills.


At Wallets, we believe in rewarding our customers for their trust and loyalty. With our new bonus program, you can earn extra rewards simply by purchasing airtime from any network and paying bills through our platform. By linking your BVN and uploading your documents via our self-service app, you unlock a world of possibilities to enhance your earning potential. Don’t miss out on this fantastic opportunity — start earning bonuses today!


Wallets is committed to continuously improving our services and finding innovative ways to benefit our customers. Stay tuned for more exciting updates and promotions. Thank you for choosing us as your preferred telecommunications provider!


Disclaimer: The bonus program is subject to terms and conditions. Please visit our website or contact our customer support for more information.
